note: USD per 1,000,000 tokens, used by `orch spend` to estimate API-billed spend (DeepSeek always; Codex/Claude when a profile has `key`). input = uncached input (the ledger folds cache writes into input, priced at the input rate); cache_read = cache hits; output. cache_write is informational only (the estimate never uses it). A personal copy at ~/.orchestra/prices.json overrides entries. DeepSeek prices are its peak rates, halved outside the peak windows (`off_peak_multiplier` 0.5): 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC Monday-Friday; weekends are off-peak. Chinese public holidays are also off-peak on DeepSeek's page but are not modelled here — on those days the estimate errs high, which is accepted. DeepSeek's cache-write rate is not listed; its 5-minute cache-write rate matches Claude's, and using it (folded into input) is accepted over Anthropic's higher 1-hour rate. A dated entry (`from`/`to`) prices a promotion that ends; an entry with only `from` is the current price. Verify against the official pages before relying on the numbers.
